import gzip, heapq, statistics
path = '/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/80149722/inputs/dataset_827735fc-2f02-4e1f-92d7-f8bae01a77e3.dat'
openf = gzip.open if path.endswith('.gz') else open
n=0; s=0.0; nonzero=0; chroms={}; top=[]; vals=[]; minpos=None
landmarks=[('chr1',1150000,1170000,'TNFRSF4'),('chr1',890000,910000,'NOC2L'),('chr6',32500000,32600000,'HLA-DRA'),('chr14',105850000,105880000,'IGH'),('chr2',87000000,87100000,'CD8A'),('chr10',6000000,6100000,'IL2RA'),('chr11',118900000,119000000,'CCND1'),('chr7',55000000,55300000,'EGFR'),('chr12',25200000,25300000,'KRAS'),('chr17',7560000,7590000,'TP53')]
land={name:0.0 for *_,name in landmarks}
with openf(path,'rt') as f:
    for line in f:
        if not line.strip() or line.startswith('#'): continue
        parts=line.rstrip('\n').split('\t')
        if len(parts)<4: continue
        chrom,start,end,val=parts[0],int(parts[1]),int(parts[2]),float(parts[3])
        n+=1; s+=val
        chroms.setdefault(chrom,[0,0.0,0])
        chroms[chrom][0]+=1; chroms[chrom][1]+=val
        if val!=0:
            nonzero+=1; chroms[chrom][2]+=1; vals.append(val)
            if minpos is None or val<minpos: minpos=val
        rec=(val,chrom,start,end)
        if len(top)<100: heapq.heappush(top,rec)
        elif val>top[0][0]: heapq.heapreplace(top,rec)
        for lc,ls,le,lname in landmarks:
            if chrom==lc and start < le and end > ls:
                land[lname]+=val
with open('top_bins.tsv','w') as out:
    out.write('chrom\tstart\tend\tvalue\n')
    for val,chrom,start,end in sorted(top, reverse=True):
        out.write(f'{chrom}\t{start}\t{end}\t{val}\n')
with open('summary.txt','w') as out:
    out.write(f'rows\t{n}\n')
    out.write(f'sum\t{s:.6f}\n')
    out.write(f'nonzero\t{nonzero}\n')
    out.write(f'min_positive\t{minpos}\n')
    out.write(f'max\t{max(v for v,_,_,_ in top)}\n')
    if vals:
        out.write(f'positive_median\t{statistics.median(vals):.6f}\n')
        out.write(f'positive_mean\t{statistics.mean(vals):.6f}\n')
    out.write('chrom\tbins\tsum\tnonzero\n')
    for c in sorted(chroms):
        out.write(f'{c}\t{chroms[c][0]}\t{chroms[c][1]:.6f}\t{chroms[c][2]}\n')
    out.write('landmark\tsum\n')
    for k,v in land.items(): out.write(f'{k}\t{v:.6f}\n')
